description: This file defines a module for lazy-loading/importing modules and objects, including classes and functions for handling lazy objects, dictionaries, and module loading, specifically used within the 'behave' testing framework.

classes.name: LazyObject
classes.description: Provides a placeholder for a class/object that is loaded lazily, implementing descriptor protocol for attribute access.

classes.name: LazyDict
classes.description: A dictionary supporting lazy loading of classes/objects with LazyObject placeholders.

methods.name: parse_scoped_name
methods.description: Parses a scoped name string into module and object names.

methods.name: make_scoped_class_name
methods.description: Builds a scoped class name string from an object or class.

methods.name: load_module
methods.description: Loads a module by name, handling different Python versions.
